description: Permanently deletes a user-selected Strategy, vault file, innovation, draft disclosure or supporting attachment. Whole-record deletion requires the fetched revision and owner/delete rights; owned files are removed, while linked records and independent copies remain. Later-stage disclosures are excluded. Attachment removal deletes its stored original and may break inline image links; separate drawings remain. Attachment IDs and owning records come from a complete attachment-aware fetch. Archived, confidential and submitted records refuse attachment removal. Requires write consent and the relevant Strategy, vault or record permissions; own-file-only vault access limits deletion accordingly. Folders are excluded. Does not withdraw service requests. Conflicts and uncertain outcomes require readback and reconciliation.
